what: When the mouse passes over square cells (photo pieces), the touched cell instantly (.01s) fills solid with the accent color, and once the hand leaves it slowly (ease-in-out) fades over 10 seconds, leaving a trail like a tail

options.[data-fx-part=tile]: Cell (child) — cell size and image are the consuming side’s css. Each cell uses an ::after curtain

note: CSS only — does not turn on on devices without a mouse (hover: none). On phones the original shows a single photo instead of the split panels
